decisions.reason: The recruitment service is an adjacent option with low keeping costs and unresolved prospects, so we keep it open while monitoring for clearer value signals.
Superyacht crew recruitment is a niche maritime service with low marginal cost and still uncertain but plausible option value, so we keep it.
The six-institution partner network shows early traction and complements our training resources, making this option valuable and inexpensive to retain.
Successful FuelEU monitoring plan submissions confirm regulatory demand and reduce uncertainty, so we keep this service as a valuable option.
The dashboard is integrated into our PAL software and complements compliance services, making it a low-cost option with favourable prospects.
The cost simulation tool is aligned with the same regulatory shift and remains an inexpensive digital option while its usage value becomes clearer.
